tips: Spears beat big and mounted units, those run down ranged units, and ranged units shred infantry. Nothing is unbeatable.
Skirmishers throw rather than shoot: they beat archers.
Every unit is priced by its parts. A silly unit is a fair unit: it just costs what it's worth.
Houses raise your population cap. Build one before you run out of room.
Reeds are wood. Bug bushes are food. Cut reeds leave bare ground behind.
Ageing up needs a building of the age before. Check the tech tree (F2) for what unlocks what.
Hold Shift to queue orders: walk here, then there, then fight.
Ctrl and a number keeps a group; the number alone picks it again.
Double-click a unit to select every one like it on screen.
Space jumps to where you were last attacked.
Attack-move (R, then click) fights everything on the way instead of walking past it.
Idle workers earn nothing. The idle worker button finds them.
Farms feed you for good once the bushes run out.
A wall buys time, not safety. Gates let only your own side through.
The AI ages up at about four to six minutes. Be ready when it does.
